name: rl-protocol
description: RL protocol contract (W047, the W035–W044 flat source-exported package pattern): the typed interface an RL TRAINER consumes/implements. The Episode is typed DATA — an opaque content-addressed episode id over the provenance triple (trajectory canonical id + binding id + experiment-evaluation id), the observation→action→outcome steps CARRIED verbatim from the W037 trajectory's own §10 evidence stream, the reward signal TYPED through W036's PolicyEvaluation (components + constraints carried verbatim — the §13 sole-P&L law is enforced at construction as a loud typed refusal), explicit scope, and immutable lineage. The TrainerPort is the minimal PURE interface a trainer implements (R054: RL is ONE learning method among many — the protocol is method-neutral: no JAX, no gradients, no trainer execution, no world stepping; W048 owns distributed episode generation, W049 owns the training adapter). The deterministic episode-batch descriptor carries episode ids in canonical order + a content-addressed batch id + an optional declared selection policy as DATA (A9).
